title: The infinitesimal lifting criterion for smooth morphisms of algebraic spaces
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: The lemma contains the substantive implication of the infinitesimal lifting criterion in the algebraic-spaces setting: a morphism that is locally of finite presentation and formally smooth is smooth. The proof passes to a surjective etale chart, interprets formal smoothness of the chart morphism through the lifting property, and derives the vanishing needed for smoothness by reducing the cohomological input to the affine case. Passing the lifting condition through the chart and converting it into the vanishing statement is the load-bearing part. Retained author proof at lines 4598-4693.
